# OpenWire News

> OpenWire is a lightning-fast, lightweight, static Progressive Web App (PWA) news aggregator that curates real-time top headlines across 12 categories, with intelligent paywall routing and automated archive fallbacks.

## Overview
OpenWire is designed to provide clean, frictionless access to news with zero advertisements, zero tracking, and zero server-side bloat. It operates as a 100% client-side PWA or a Jamstack pre-rendered application hosted on static web storage (such as Azure Blob Storage Static Websites, GitHub Pages, or any CDN).

## Key Capabilities
- **12 Real-Time Topic Feeds**: Continuously aggregated headlines covering major world events, technology, science, business, regional/local news, and artificial intelligence.
- **Intelligent Paywall Routing Engine**: Evaluates publisher domains against a client-side strategy registry:
  - *Free / Open Access*: Instant direct linking (e.g., BBC, NPR, AP, The Guardian, CBC).
  - *Standard Paywall Bypass*: Routed through clean reader engines and unwall services (e.g., smry.ai, Freedium, archive reader).
  - *Hard Paywalls*: Scans Archive.today (`archive.is`) for readable snapshots. If unavailable, headlines are flagged and disabled to prevent dead ends.
- **Fair-Share Feed Weaving**: Fair-share quotas and anti-clustering algorithms prevent any single publisher or outlet from dominating a feed.
- **Client-Side Customization**: Users can add custom topics, configure custom RSS feeds, tweak paywall rules, and export/import settings locally via browser storage (`localStorage`).
- **Offline Capable & Installable**: PWA architecture with Service Worker caching for instant loading and offline review on iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux.

## Static Data Feeds (JSON)
OpenWire publishes structured, pre-compiled JSON feeds containing article titles, sources, publication timestamps, domain classification, and direct/archive URLs:
- [Top Stories Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_top.json): Main curated top headlines
- [Latest News Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_latest.json): Most recent breaking news stream
- [AI & Machine Learning Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_ai.json): Artificial intelligence and machine learning developments
- [Technology Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_technology.json): Tech industry, computing, and consumer electronics
- [Business & Finance Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_business.json): Markets, economics, and corporate news
- [World News Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_world.json): Global international reporting and affairs
- [Science Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_science.json): Scientific discoveries, space exploration, and medicine
- [Canada National Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_canada.json): Canadian national coverage
- [Vancouver Local Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_vancouver.json): Metro Vancouver local news and transit
- [British Columbia Regional Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_bc.json): Regional news across British Columbia
- [Entertainment Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_entertainment.json): Culture, film, television, and arts
- [Sports Feed](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/data/news_sports.json): Scores, athletics, and league updates
- [Primary News Index](https://openwire.news/OpenWire/news.json): Root aggregate news bundle
